svg.title: Left: on the synthetic no-signal dataset, the naive PSR of the best configuration so far rises with the number of configurations registered while its deflated Sharpe ratio stays well below it. Right: the best Sharpe ratio so far and SR0, the expected best of that many skill-less trials, for the no-signal and planted-signal datasets.
